name: do-epic-shit-demo-web
description: Modern asset pipeline for the DO-EPIC-SHIT demo.
author: Lars Moelleken

scripts.clean: shx rm -f css/*.css css/*.css.map css-min/* js/plugins.js js-min/*
scripts.build:assets: shx mkdir -p css css-min js-min fonts && shx cp node_modules/font-awesome/css/font-awesome.min.css css/font-awesome.min.css && shx cp node_modules/jquery/dist/jquery.min.js js-min/jquery.min.js && shx cp -r node_modules/bootstrap-sass/assets/fonts/bootstrap/* fonts/ && shx cp -r node_modules/font-awesome/fonts/* fonts/
scripts.build:js:minify: terser js/plugins.js --compress --mangle --comments '/^!/' -o js-min/plugins.js && terser js/app.js --compress --mangle --comments '/^!/' -o js-min/app.js
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:assets && npm run build:css:sass && npm run build:css:prefix && npm run build:css:min && npm run build:js:plugins && npm run build:js:minify
